brief: Retreat the current record cursor by 256 bytes with an unsigned clamp.
notes: Original bytes and execution establish argument widths and access order.
Spans are host byte views; original 32-bit address identities are explicit where needed.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete original body on supplied scalar state and valid byte spans. Copy cases include overlapping and unaligned views with the original read/write order.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: All 32-bit cursor and base bit patterns. This body does not dereference either address identity; subtraction wraps and the clamp is unsigned.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 64 synthetic original-execution cases matched bit-exact by MSVC and Zig/Clang runners. See docs/recovery/record-stack.md.
